name: Partial Differential Equations and Applications
description: First order PDEs: classification and examples of PDEs, method of characteristic, complete and general solutions. Second order PDEs in two independent variables: classification, examples and canonical form. Laplace equation: fundamental solution, Poisson's equation, harmonic functions and their properties (without proof), maximum principle, Green's function, Dirichlet's principle and method of separation of variables. Heat equation: fundamental solution, mean value theorem and maximum principle (without proof), uniqueness results and method of separation of variables. Wave equation: D' Alembert's formula, method of separation of variables, method of spherical means (n=2, 3), Duhamel`s principle and energy method for uniqueness. Black-Scholes PDE and heat equation.
